# Integral Electrics Qld

## About
Integral Electrics Qld are a Cairns electrician and solutions provider with 15+ years of experience. They deliver electrical services and products with an absolute commitment to excellence, providing honest advice and the best solutions to each client's specific electrical requirements. They are a Master Electricians member serving Cairns and surrounds, from Gordonvale to Port Douglas.

## Services
Electrical Work
Gate Automation
Security Services
Air Conditioning
EV Charger Installation

## Service Areas
Cairns and surrounds, from Gordonvale to Port Douglas
